text:
rachel-finance: Quick announcement  refresh to corporate card & vendor consolidation policy. New guidance goes into effect immediately. Please read: https://redwood.company/finance/card-consolidation :card_index:

procurement-bot: POLICY UPDATE by @rachel-finance
- Personal cards: stopped. Employees must not submit personal card charges for reimbursement except pre-approved travel.
- Corporate card holders: teams should consolidate recurring vendor subscriptions onto shared team cards where feasible to reduce fees and simplify vendor management.
- Single-seat software: prefer virtual cards assigned to the team owner rather than personal cards.
- High-risk vendors (access to production): require procurement onboarding even if billed to corporate card.

rachel-finance: Why this change? Fewer individual cards = simpler reconciliation, better spend visibility, and quicker vendor onboarding. We'll reassign cards where duplicates exist.

alex-hr: Question  what about interview travel and candidate meals currently on folk's personal cards?

jamie-eng: also curious  our infra lead uses a personal card for a side vendor that bills monthly. How should they migrate?

rachel-finance: For interview/candidate expenses, HR should use the `Travel & Meals` corporate card program. If you used a personal card, submit expenses by end of the month with manager note and we'll reimburse, but moving forward use the corporate travel card.

rachel-finance: For side vendors or team tools, open `/procure request-card` to request a virtual card or a physical team card. We'll migrate recurring subscriptions and set the vendor as an approved payee. Jamies' infra lead should request a virtual card and we'll transfer billing.

procurement-bot: New commands:
- `/procure request-card` to request a team virtual/physical card
- `/procure card-transfer` to request billing transfer from a personal card to a corporate card

jamie-eng: timeline for transfers? We have an upcoming renewal in two weeks.

ceo-adam: if renewals are imminent, tag the request `urgent-renewal` and include an exec note; finance will prioritize. We don't want services to lapse.

rachel-finance: SLA: card transfer requests aim for 72 hours; urgent-renewal tag aims for 24 hours. Please include invoice/portal screenshot.

alex-hr: Will finance provide a list of current corporate cardholders and team assignments? HR needs that to coordinate travel bookings.

rachel-finance: Yes  I'll publish a CSV of active cardholders and their team allocations to the finance drive by EOD and create a short migration checklist.

procurement-bot: policy version: 2026-04-10_card_consolidation_v1. Archived prior versions at https://redwood.company/finance/archive

rachel-finance: final note: any vendors that must remain on individual cards for contractual reasons must be escalated to `#finance-escalations` with justification. Otherwise please start migration requests this week.

jamie-eng: Copy. I'll ask my lead to open a `/procure request-card` now.

alex-hr: Thanks, sharing with HR ops.
